serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Dinner is ready!
You: Oh! You prepared something for me again?
Bot: Yep! It’s something special today!
You: What is it?
Bot: It’s a steak with baked potatoes! Enjoy!
Bot: This special beef costs extra money, so I hope that you will appreciate its taste!
You: Let me get right into it.
You: I must say that it looks super fancy this time. It’s like I’m in some expensive restaurant or something.
Bot: That’s exactly the presentation I wanted to achieve.
As I cut into the steak, I see a red fluid coming out of it.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: Um, {f_botName}, I think that your steak might be raw.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: That’s not possible! I followed the recipe step by step! Let me take a look!
Damn, she got mad.
Bot: Silly Master! That’s not blood, that’s just water and myoglobin! Because of the cut you made I can clearly see that this is a perfectly made medium-rare steak!
#bot.Expression.clear
You: I’m sorry, ok? I never ate a steak before. 
Bot: Alright, I will forgive you this time.
Bot: Now hurry up and start eating it. I want you to tell me how good it is.
You: Jeez…
